insights.one_liner: Young Delft deep-tech start-up building drone (UAV) situational-awareness software for military use; has one software internship that mentions visas.

culture.text: Calls itself a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up working on autonomy, perception and defence.
Builds onboard software for military drones using low-cost, widely available sensors and computers.

open.text: Its one open job, a software engineering internship in Delft, needs no Dutch and mentions visas.
Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Plans to build a line-up of connected products aimed at European safety.
